{{Top|leg}}
An '''invertebrate''' was any creature without bones or an internal skeleton. Examples of invertebrates included [[airborne zooplankton]], the [[floater]], the [[Spider/Legends|spider]], the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]], the [[Flea/Legends|flea]], and the [[Fly/Legends|fly]].
